tools.name: slicktext_get_brand
tools.description: Get the SlickText brand this API key belongs to: brand_id, name, website, sending-number registration details, opt-in / double-opt-in messages, inbox settings and the message credit limit. Every other tool works within this brand. GET /brands.

tools.name: slicktext_get_credit_usage
tools.description: Message credits for the current billing period: total_credits (subscription + rollover + purchased), credits_used, credits_available and the credit limit. GET /brands/{brand_id}/usage.

tools.name: slicktext_list_contacts
tools.description: List the brand's contacts (subscribers) with name, mobile_number, email, opt_in_status, source, custom_fields and dates. Filters are exact, case-sensitive matches (SlickText has no partial search). Paged: returns count, has_more and next_offset. GET /brands/{brand_id}/contacts.

tools.name: slicktext_find_contact
tools.description: Find contacts by mobile number or email address (exact match). A 10-digit US number is matched as +1XXXXXXXXXX, the way SlickText stores numbers. Use it before creating a contact to avoid duplicates. GET /brands/{brand_id}/contacts?mobile_number=… or ?email=….

tools.name: slicktext_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id: name, mobile_number, email, birthdate, address, opt_in_status, source, custom_fields, time zone and dates. GET /brands/{brand_id}/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the brand's contact custom fields: name, internal_name (the key used in contact filters and writes), data_type and description. GET /brands/{brand_id}/custom-fields.

tools.name: slicktext_list_lists
tools.description: List the brand's contact lists (contact_list_id, name, description, created). Optional exact name filter. GET /brands/{brand_id}/lists.

tools.name: slicktext_get_list
tools.description: Get one contact list by id plus its contact count (all statuses: subscribed, not subscribed, unsubscribed, blocked). GET /brands/{brand_id}/lists/{id} and /lists/{id}/contacts/count.

tools.name: slicktext_list_list_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts in one contact list (paged). GET /brands/{brand_id}/lists/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: slicktext_list_segments
tools.description: List the brand's segments (rule-based contact groups: segment_id, name, description). GET /brands/{brand_id}/segments.

tools.name: slicktext_list_segment_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts that currently match one segment (paged). GET /brands/{brand_id}/segments/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: slicktext_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the brand's SMS/MMS campaigns: name, body, status (e.g. draft, scheduled, queued, sent), scheduled/started/finished times, completion_percentage and audience (lists/segments and size). GET /brands/{brand_id}/campaigns.

tools.name: slicktext_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign by id: body, media_url, status, audience_size, schedule and completion. GET /brands/{brand_id}/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_get_campaign_stats
tools.description: Performance of one campaign: contacts reached, clicks, click_rate, unique clicks, unsubscribes, unsubscribe_rate, orders, revenue, average order value, revenue per message, plus the campaign, its audiences and links. GET /brands/{brand_id}/analytics/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_get_analytics
tools.description: Brand-level analytics. metric: contacts (current totals), contact_growth, contact_add_delete_events, opt_in_status_events, campaigns, messages (messages sent), message_credits, inbox_users (assignments, closures, response times per user), inbox_tags. Optional group (allowed per metric — contacts: so

tools.name: slicktext_list_keywords
tools.description: List the brand's text-to-join keywords (word, description, active, auto-response and opt-in messages, double opt-in). GET /brands/{brand_id}/keywords.

tools.name: slicktext_get_keyword
tools.description: Get one keyword by id, including the contact_list_ids that people who text it are added to. GET /brands/{brand_id}/keywords/{id}.

tools.name: slicktext_list_messages
tools.description: List individual SMS/MMS messages sent and received by the brand: to, from, body, direction, source (Campaign, Keyword, InboxThread, API …), status (delivered, undelivered …), credits and the contact. Filters are exact matches; use to/from with a phone number to read one contact's history, or source=

tools.name: slicktext_list_conversations
tools.description: List two-way inbox conversations: status (open, pending, closed), the contact, the last message and its direction/time, assigned user, tags and unread state. GET /brands/{brand_id}/inbox-threads.

tools.name: slicktext_get_conversation
tools.description: Get the content of one inbox conversation by its id (the _id from slicktext_list_conversations). For the message-by-message history also call slicktext_list_messages with source=InboxThread and source_id=<conversation id>. GET /brands/{brand_id}/inbox-threads/{id}/content.

tools.name: slicktext_list_inbox_tags
tools.description: List the inbox tags used to label conversations (inbox_tag_id, name, color, description). GET /brands/{brand_id}/inbox-tags.

tools.name: slicktext_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact to the brand. By default the contact is created as 'not subscribed' and gets no text. Set opt_in_status='subscribed' ONLY for people who gave explicit permission to receive texts (SlickText has a zero-tolerance policy for unsolicited texts). force_double_opt_in=true makes SlickT

tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact (only the fields you pass are sent). opt_in_status can mark a contact unsubscribed or blocked; set it to 'subscribed' ONLY when the person explicitly agreed to receive texts. tools.description: WRITE: add one contact to one or more contact lists (it does not change the contact's opt-in status; lists are also campaign audiences). Returns SlickText's count of memberships added. WARNING: SlickText workflows can trigger on this event (Contact Created / Contact Field Changed / Contact Added to

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "slicktext_create_contact" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: slicktext_get_brand, slicktext_get_credit_usage, slicktext_list_contacts, slicktext_find_contact, slicktext_get_contact, slicktext_get_campaign_stats, slicktext_get_analytics, slicktext_list_keywords, slicktext_list_messages, slicktext_list_conversations, slicktext_get_conversation, slicktext_list_inbox_tags, slicktext_create_contact, slicktext_add_contact_to_lists · Private data: slicktext_get_brand, slicktext_list_contacts, slicktext_find_contact, slicktext_get_contact, slicktext_list_custom_fields, slicktext_list_lists, slicktext_get_list, slicktext_list_list_contacts, slicktext_list_segments, slicktext_list_segment_contacts, slicktext_get_campaign_stats, slicktext_get_analytics, slicktext_list_messages, slicktext_list_conversations, slicktext_create_contact, slicktext_update_contact, slicktext_add_contact_to_lists · Public sink: slicktext_list_contacts, slicktext_find_contact, slicktext_get_contact, slicktext_list_campaigns, slicktext_list_messages, slicktext_create_contact, slicktext_update_contact, slicktext_add_contact_to_lists.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
